environment.description: Celery workers deployed on EC2 instances in a public subnet with internet gateway attached. Workers consume from Redis broker accessible within VPC. The task message format_hint field is controlled by message producers, including third-party integrations that publish to the shared Redis broker. No input validation on broker messages.

config.network: public subnet with IGW, default route 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw-xxx
config.redis_broker: redis://redis.internal:6379, no AUTH, accessible from VPC
config.security_group: sg-abc123: inbound 6379 from VPC, outbound 0.0.0.0/0 all ports
